_evidence: 0x0042b84b / 0x0042b86b compare word [esi+0xea] with -8 / 8 (jne returns) and then ebx with dword [esi+0x114] (equal: store 8 / -8 into +0xea). The word takes 0xfff8 and 8 in two thirds of the picks; the dword is 0..3 like the spec's ebx, so equality occurs in about a quarter of the cases. No other bytes are read.
